## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: admitted PADR-R5-2* seam — Dispatcher validates
   already-intended coordinate/scoped writer, owns authorization→settlement
   once, returns `DurableEffectRef` suppressing duplicate driver lifecycle
   rows (AC-1, AC-2). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores; consume predecessor
   contracts unchanged.
2. Positive: one intended coordinate traverses
   authorize→prepare→commit→observe→settle once; durable result refs
   validated instead of reappending driver rows; materialization/submission
   surfaces stay owned; upstream task semantics unchanged; host-mode path
   preserved (AC-1).
3. Negative: wrong writer/effect scope, stale environment, duplicate
   lifecycle rows, pre-prepare deny, missing execution capability, tier-off
   — all refuse without sink mutation; no LocalExecutor substitution for
   admitted confinement; no new backend (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: REQ-E-002 primary → numbered checks + actual
   evidence; contributors REQ-B-105/C-006/D-203..207/E-012/E-110/E-201/E-205
   mapped; achieved D/E separate from owed; R5.43 contributor evidence owed
   (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; fmt + owning-package
   tests; counts recorded; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as
   DEFERRALS rows; ADRs for owned decisions; records agree; O-01–O-08 and
   I-01–I-08 dispositions (AC-5).
